origin.description: Constructs date-time objects from numeric representations.
origin.usage: stri_datetime_create(year = NULL, month = NULL, day = NULL, hour = 0L, minute = 0L, second = 0, lenient = FALSE, tz = NULL, locale = NULL)

arguments.name: year
arguments.text: Integer vector. 0 is 1 BCE. NULL means the current year.

arguments.name: month
arguments.text: Integer vector, 1-based. NULL means the current month.

arguments.name: day
arguments.text: Integer vector. NULL means the current day.

arguments.name: hour
arguments.text: Integer vector. NULL means the current hour. The default is 0.

arguments.name: minute
arguments.text: Integer vector. NULL means the current minute. The default is 0.

arguments.name: second
arguments.text: Numeric vector. Fractional seconds are allowed. NULL means the current second. The default is 0.

arguments.name: lenient
arguments.text: Single logical value. TRUE rolls an invalid date forward.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default time zone, or one ICU time zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale. @calendar=name selects a calendar.

origin.details: Vectorized over year, month, day, hour, minute, and second. A NULL field is filled from the current time. An invalid field is missing when lenient is FALSE. The result is a POSIXct in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
origin.example:
x <- stri_datetime_create(2015, 1, 1, tz = "UTC")
cat(paste0("stri_datetime_create(2015, 1, 1, tz = \"UTC\") returns ", sprintf("%.0f", unclass(x)), ".\n"))

translation.usage: stri_datetime_create(year=None, month=None, day=None, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, lenient=False, tz=None, locale=None)

arguments.name: year
arguments.text: An int, NA, or a list of those. None means the current year.

arguments.name: month
arguments.text: An int, NA, or a list of those. Months start at 1. None means the current month.

arguments.name: day
arguments.text: An int, NA, or a list of those. None means the current day.

arguments.name: hour
arguments.text: An int, NA, or a list of those. None means the current hour. The default is 0.

arguments.name: minute
arguments.text: An int, NA, or a list of those. None means the current minute. The default is 0.

arguments.name: second
arguments.text: A number, NA, or a list of those. None means the current second. The default is 0.

arguments.name: lenient
arguments.text: True rolls an invalid date forward. NA is an error.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: None or "" for the default ICU zone, or one zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: None or "" for the default locale. @calendar=name selects a calendar.

translation.details: None for a field is filled from the current instant. Hour, minute, and second stay 0 unless passed as None. A missing field makes that instant missing. Fractional seconds are rounded with R's fround to milliseconds. A result that ICU cannot resolve is NA. The value is seconds since the Unix epoch.
translation.value: A float, or NA. A list or tuple returns a list. An empty argument returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_datetime_create
x = stri_datetime_create(2015, 1, 1, tz="UTC")
print(f'stri_datetime_create(2015, 1, 1, tz = "UTC") returns {x:.0f}.')
